title: zlrx.1: Wire save_recipient calls after successful OSCORE unprotect in lichen-node
description: oscore 0.1.3 added ContextStateStore::save_recipient and Context::recipient_replay_state() but no caller invokes them yet. After each successful begin_unprotect_request/begin_unprotect_response in lichen-node (secure.rs, secure_dispatch.rs, rpl_stack/secure.rs), call store.save_recipient(&ctx.context_id(), &ctx.recipient_replay_state()). This makes the recipient replay window durable across restarts.
